question: which UNVERIFIED mass could a declared event order turn into UNSAFE mass, and which admission decisions could it change

rule.admission: Problem 1: admitted at eps iff m^U = 0 and m^V <= eps in each dataset; a decision is fixed under every declared order when the view has UNSAFE mass or no tie-only rows
rule.declared_order: an order that the released labels satisfy fixes z, so it only removes states; UNSAFE and NONDETERMINED verdicts and query defects do not depend on z
rule.path_A: every single-label tie fiber is tie-only (all states of a fiber share the carrier)
rule.path_B: an open single-label fiber is tie-only unless some rival strictly beats the observed label at a fiber state; that state is re-checked in integer arithmetic
rule.path_C: no certificate path, so no fiber can become UNSAFE
rule.public_fibers: every open Path B fiber except the DF fibers with one query-conforming anchor, with its strictly winning rival state or, if tie-only, the exact optimum of every rival program
